resolved_findings.issue: The BF beta-learning saturation check used only the new effective cap, so raising 62.5 to 80 could conceal the previous saturated output and permit beta to rise from 0.50 to 0.55.
resolved_findings.fix: Retain the last committed effective cap, advance it only on row append, clear it on reset, and compare previous D against min(previous effective cap,current effective cap).
